entries.name: PDF
entries.description: Read, extract, split, merge, fill, rotate and OCR PDF files. Useful alongside exam-prep when a student has a past paper as a scanned PDF rather than as text.

steps: Clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills or download the skills/pdf directory.
Copy skills/pdf into your agent's skills directory (~/.claude/skills/pdf for Claude Code).
Install its Python dependencies: pip install pypdf pdfplumber.
Start a new session and ask your agent to work with a PDF.

accesses: PDF files you point it at
your local shell, to run Python PDF tooling

entries.name: Exam Prep
entries.description: Build practice question sets from a course, module or topic, mark a student's answers, diagnose which topics are weak, and plan revision against an exam date. Use when a student wants to practise, be quizzed, sit a mock paper, check answers, or work out what to revise before an exam.
